description: Pay for the full transcript of a job whose get_job status is "payment_required", with a card your user shared through a Stripe Shared Payment Token (MPP). Call without payment: you get a payment challenge with the exact price in EUR. Your MPP client pays it and calls again. Without an MPP wallet, show payment_url from get_job to your user instead.

job_id.description: job_id returned by transcribe_url or create_upload.

robot_key.description: The robot_key you received with your first job. Required to read or start your jobs.

name: pay_job
title: Pay for a job
